sources: Tide Surge 3-piece, rmxlinux Json/SkillData/passive_equipsuit_burst_01 (game 1.6): Skill DMG + skill_dmg_up on the stat panel; buff_equipsuit_burst_01: when the wearer applies an Arts Infliction (abilityEvent 102 with each element's infliction tag) and the target then has at least stack_cond (2) stacks of it, it creates buff_equipsuit_burst_01_spelldmgup (attributes 51–54, Arts DMG + spell_dmg_up, `duration` 15 s), stacking type 2, max 1: a new one refreshes. minStacks is the literal 2 (stack_cond can't be named there). Whether an infliction that forms a reaction counts follows the open item Arcane R3 (interim: it doesn't; in-game test 35).
